breakdown.description: The prompt treats the effective-length factor K as if it affected only the mode shape, even though K directly enters the Euler buckling load through the effective length K L.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses P_cr = π² E I / (K L)² with K = 0.5 directly in the denominator, matching the ground truth. It does not include the erroneous instruction that K affects only the mode shape and not the buckling load formula. The computed result (~1.58 × 10⁶ N) confirms K is properly applied in (KL)², as this equals π² × 200000 × 800000 / (0.5 × 2000)² = the correct value.
